searchText: Been looking at the API required for sync committees. I have put together an initial set of endpoints (roughly based on those for attestations). Would very much appreciate the client teams taking a look. If we can get a first version nailed down early it should help with testing for Altair. https://hackmd.io/@QYHAVYiHRg65pdI_CEm7Eg/syncommitteeapi <@539495253418180618> <@144468805697929216> nice work, we'll review it ah yes this is great <@!144468805697929216> i'll take a look later today drafted up a change to blocks https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-APIs/pull/129 for comment at least, not sure if we end up keeping it 🙂 but it'll be a good conversation starter hopefully There's very likely better ways of doing the change, I'm not really up on the openapi / yaml thing so i just kinda started hacking away thanks for the PR! Haven't had a chance to take a good look at it but on quick glance it makes sense to version the objects like this. Trying to go with optional isn't going to work when some fields must be in v_x_ and not in v_y_. (although: altona?) imo we should move towards a v1 release and then cut a v2 release soon for altair as well did i get the name wrong? :/ altona is an earlier testnet w/ a very similar name to altair 🙂 i thought i got most changed hehe I think we pretty much froze the current master as v1 a while back. yeah i think i was told it hasn't "officially" been released as such so just to formalize it and then get a v2 going my guess is any apis that stay v1 can be maintained but shouldnt be altered in an incompatible way definitely and any 'breaking' change gets a 'v2' and lets try to not break v2 too soon 🙂 i guess the block change i tried to have 'v2' be something where the data structure can change, and we can add a new 'version' without breaking the api

Been looking at the API required for sync committees.  I have put together an initial set of endpoints (roughly based on those for attestations).  Would very much appreciate the client teams taking a look.  If we can get a first version nailed down early it should help with testing for Altair.

https://hackmd.io/@QYHAVYiHRg65pdI_CEm7Eg/syncommitteeapi
